facets.gloss: The extent to which you unleash feelings of kindness, closeness, and accessibility in one-to-one interactions.
facets.daily_meaning: A high score makes it easier for others to feel embraced; a low score makes it easier for others to appear reserved, slow to warm up, or need distance.
facets.why_it_matters: It can distinguish between two things: whether it requires crowd stimulation and whether it can create a warm connection.

facets.gloss: Your natural preference for group situations, lively interactions, and social density.
facets.daily_meaning: High scores are more likely to gain energy from groups; low scores require low-density interaction and solitude to recover.
facets.why_it_matters: It explains not only whether a person can socialize, but how frequently a person can tolerate social interaction.

facets.gloss: Do you naturally occupy the expressive position, make demands and influence the direction of the context?
facets.daily_meaning: Those with high scores are more likely to take the initiative to promote issues; those with low scores are more likely to observe before deciding whether to speak out.
facets.why_it_matters: It affects whether one's ideas will enter external systems in time.

facets.gloss: Your preferred pace of life, density of tasks, and level of physical energy.
facets.daily_meaning: High scores are more tolerant of fast pace; low scores require slower starts and low-interference rhythms.
facets.why_it_matters: It explains that fatigue is sometimes not a lack of motivation, but a mismatch in rhythm.

facets.gloss: Your need for fresh, intense, and high-arousal experiences.
facets.daily_meaning: High scorers are easily attracted to challenges, changes and strong stimulation; low scorers prefer contexts with low noise and low fluctuations.
facets.why_it_matters: It affects whether you view stimulation as fuel or as a load to be managed.

facets.gloss: The frequency with which you naturally experience and express feelings of lightness, excitement, and pleasure.
facets.daily_meaning: High scores are more likely to express happiness and expectation; low scores are not necessarily negative, but the expression of emotions is more low-key.
facets.why_it_matters: It can help distinguish between "no feelings on the inside" and "infrequent high-frequency expression on the outside".
